name: allocation-api

dependencies.name: sendgrid
dependencies.description: Sends allocation-request-submitted and allocation-decision emails to Engagement Managers and Resource Managers.

description: Ballerina REST API owning engagements, the team member roster, allocation requests, and confirmed allocations. Enforces the request-approval workflow, computes per-team-member utilization, and warns (without blocking) on over-100% allocation. Sends notification emails via SendGrid. Does not serve any UI and issues no auth tokens itself — the gateway validates the caller's token.
